title: SEATauBench: Progressively Adapting Tool-Agent-User Evaluation Into Low-Resource Southeast Asian Languages
abstract: arXiv:2606.28715v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While AI development and evaluation for Southeast Asia (SEA) has grown rapidly, agent capabilities in regional languages are still poorly understood despite its importance to sovereign AI. To fill this gap, we introduce SEATauBench, the first agent-focused evaluation framework for SEA sovereign AI. It adapts Tau2-Bench to five languages---Mandarin, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, and Filipino---and evaluates agents across progressively localized settings that vary the language of user-agent interaction, tool specifications, and task domains. Across three models, we find that English agent capabilities transfer reasonably well when only the conversation language changes, but quality and robustness degrade sharply as more task contexts are localized, with the largest losses in full domain adaptation. translated_title: SEATauBench：将工具-智能体-用户评估渐进式适配至低资源东南亚语言
translated_abstract: 尽管面向东南亚（SEA）的AI开发与评估迅速增长，但智能体在区域语言中的能力仍鲜为人知，而这对于主权AI至关重要。为填补这一空白，我们提出了SEATauBench，这是首个聚焦于东南亚主权AI的智能体评估框架。该框架将Tau2-Bench适配至五种语言——普通话、越南语、泰语、印尼语和他加禄语，并在渐进式本地化的设置中评估智能体，这些设置改变了用户与智能体交互的语言、工具规范和任务领域。通过对三个模型的实验，我们发现当仅改变对话语言时，英语智能体的能力迁移效果尚可，但随着更多任务语境被本地化，质量和鲁棒性急剧下降，其中完全领域适配的损失最大。我们还强调了仅用英语评估智能体在预测东南亚语言智能体能力方面的局限性。更广泛地说，SEATau...
tldr: 提出了首个面向东南亚主权AI的智能体评估框架SEATauBench，将Tau2-Bench适配至五种东南亚语言，发现仅改变对话语言时英语智能体能力迁移良好，但随着任务语境本地化程度加深，性能和鲁棒性急剧下降。
en_tdlr: SEATauBench, the first agent-focused evaluation framework for SEA sovereign AI, adapts Tau2-Bench to five Southeast Asian languages and reveals that while English agent capabilities transfer well when only conversation language changes, performance degrades sharply as task contexts become progressively localized.
